name: Menu
description:
The Menu component displays a list of actions or options that the user can choose from, opened from a trigger such as a button.

`<Menu>` provides the menu state to its parts and renders no element. Use `Menu.Trigger` with `asChild` to open the menu from your own button, and `Menu.ContentGroup` to render the positioned menu content. Group items with `Menu.ItemGroup` and `Menu.ItemGroupLabel`, divide them with `Menu.Separator`, and use `Menu.CheckboxItem` or `Menu.RadioItemGroup` with `Menu.RadioItem` for selectable options. The `positioning` prop places the menu relative to its trigger.

props.name: triggerValue

props.name: immediate
props.description: Whether to synchronize the present change immediately or defer it to the next frame

props.name: lazyMount
props.description: Whether to enable lazy mounting

props.name: unmountOnExit
props.description: Whether to unmount on exit.

props.name: hideMode
props.description: How to hide content when mounted but not present. - `'display-none'`: HTML `hidden` attribute. Effects stay alive. - `'activity'`: React 19 `<Activity mode="hidden">`. Effects pause. Requires React 19+.

props.name: skipAnimationOnMount
props.description: Whether to allow the initial presence animation.
